sources.title: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash + Flash Cyber (variants, pricing, availability)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber on 2026-09-02 as the same foundational intelligence in two variants: Flash as the general workhorse, Flash Cyber for trusted defenders via the Fairwind Program.
claims.context: Dated first-party Keyword announcement consumed; third Flash release in six weeks per page.

claims.text: Flash introductory pricing is $0.75/M input and $3.75/M output through 2026-12-31, moving to $1.50/M input and $7.50/M output from 2027-01-01.
claims.context: Price points and expiry as stated on the announcement page.

claims.text: Flash capability claims: long-horizon coding and agent gains, Vals Finance Agent V2 and Harvey Legal wins over 3.7 Flash and other frontier models; HLE-Verified 54.9%; extra reasoning/tool-call diligence at higher effort levels with higher token use.
claims.context: Lab-reported benchmark framing; methodology pages not consumed in this run.

claims.text: Flash Cyber claims: CyberGym frontier-level discovery; 70%+ success on an internal 20-language vulnerability-discovery benchmark; CWE-Bench pass@1 47.2% vs 47.8% leading frontier model at lower cost; Chrome 2.6x correct patches, Wiz +7.5-9.7% recall at 2.3-5.2x lower cost, and one critical Google finding in under 2 hours.
claims.context: Vendor-reported cyber figures including Google-internal and Wiz-attributed results; externally unreproduced.

limitations.text: All benchmark, patch-recall, and discovery figures are vendor-reported without consumed methodology.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Internal 20-language benchmark is undisclosed; CyberGym/CWE-Bench runs are Google-reported.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Wiz/Chrome-team attributions are relayed by Google, not independently verified.
